title: 100STYLE walks
legend: Readable key poses (the my-3D2dge format). Times in seconds; every other number is a whole number. Rig frame: forward, right, up.
L and R are the figure's own sides. Directions are percentages and need not add up: [100, 0, 0] and [50, 0, 0] agree.
hips   [forward, right, up]   the pelvis, in percent of standing hip height (100 = standing, 55 = sitting on a chair)
body   [turn, lean, tilt]     the pelvis, degrees: turn + = toward the right, lean + = forward, tilt + = toward the right
chest  [turn, lean, tilt]     the chest, relative to the pelvis; head [turn, lean, tilt] relative to the chest
shL shR    [reach, shrug]     degrees the shoulder swings forward (into a punch or an aim) and up, from rest

armL armR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  which way the arm points from the shoulder to the fist, in chest space (out + = away from the body on that side; [0, 0, -100] hangs down, [100, 0, 0] punches ahead); bend = elbow bend in degrees (0 = straight); twist = degrees the elbow swings round the arm from its natural direction (back and down)
legL legR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  hip to ankle in pelvis space; bend: the knee; twist: from pointing forward
footL footR [down, out, toes]   degrees the foot points down from standing, turns outward, and the toes bend up
blade  [forward, right, up]   (sword clips) the direction of a blade held in the right fist, in chest space
root   [forward, right]       (clips that travel) how far the whole body has moved, in percent of standing hip height
speed  (a clip's header: loops that walk or run in place) how fast the capture travelled, percent of standing hip height a second

100STYLE.origin: The 100STYLE dataset: one performer walking, running, sidestepping and idling in 100 styles, captured by Ian Mason, Sebastian Starke and Taku Komura (Real-Time Style Modelling of Human Locomotion via Feature-Wise Transformations and Local Motion Phases, 2022). Each clip is a forward walk cut at its best cycle inside the frames the dataset marks as the style.

Aeroplane_Walk.desc: Both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side

Angry_Walk.desc: Swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed

ArmsBySide_Walk.desc: Keep arms fixed by side and do not move them

Balance_Walk.desc: Arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side

BentKnees_Walk.desc: Bend knees as much as possible

BouncyLeft_Walk.desc: Step normally with right foot but spring off left foot

BouncyRight_Walk.desc: Step normally with left foot but spring off right foot

Cat_Walk.desc: Use hands as paws - step opposite hand and foot

CrossOver_Walk.desc: Step each foot in front of other leg

CrowdAvoidance_Walk.desc: Occasionally turning shoulders or turn sideways to avoid others

Dinosaur_Walk.desc: Like a t-rex arms close to body dinosaur posture

DragLeftLeg_Walk.desc: Drag left foot along the floor

DragRightLeg_Walk.desc: Drag right foot along the floor

Drunk_Walk.desc: Stumbling around at random. Various foot step sizes and arm motions

FairySteps_Walk.desc: One foot in front of the other so the heel touches the toe

Flapping_Walk.desc: Flap arms as wings on tiptoes

FlickLegs_Walk.desc: Knees together and flick legs to sides as moving

GracefulArms_Walk.desc: One arm across chest the other extended walk tall

HandsBetweenLegs_Walk.desc: Bent back – legs wide - hands swing between legs

HandsInPockets_Walk.desc: Place hands in pockets and walk and run

Heavyset_Walk.desc: Walking as a muscle man tensed biceps

HighKnees_Walk.desc: Lift knees high but only knees – not marching

InTheDark_Walk.desc: Feeling around as if in darkness

KarateChop_Walk.desc: Open hands swing hand with each step to do a karate chop

LawnMower_Walk.desc: Roll hands over one another like disco move and tilt torso forwards and then back

LimpLeft_Walk.desc: Keep left leg straight and limp

LimpRight_Walk.desc: Keep right leg straight and limp

LookUp_Walk.desc: Tilt head to look at ceiling

Lunge_Walk.desc: Wide step bend knee every step in lunge position

March_Walk.desc: High knees swing arms at elbows

Monk_Walk.desc: Interlock hands in front of pelvis head slightly bowed

Morris_Walk.desc: Swing hands side to side as if waving hankies. Bouncy/skipping footsteps

OnHeels_Walk.desc: Walk on heels with toes raised

OnToesBentForward_Walk.desc: As bent forward style but on tip toes

OnToesCrouched_Walk.desc: As crouched style but on tip toes

PendulumHands_Walk.desc: Squat slightly make right angle with elbows and swing hands freely

Proud_Walk.desc: Straight back arms move as if marching to a lesser degree

Quail_Walk.desc: Arms straight by sides slightly back very small quick steps

RaisedLeftArm_Walk.desc: Raise left arm perpendicular to body

RaisedRightArm_Walk.desc: Raise right arm perpendicular to body

Roadrunner_Walk.desc: Arms behind as wings pick up knees - bent a little

Robot_Walk.desc: Stiff movements arms bending at elbows

Rocket_Walk.desc: Bent to flat back with hands behind as thrusters

Rushed_Walk.desc: Rushing about swinging arms for extra momentum

ShieldedLeft_Walk.desc: Squat down with left arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Right arm as if holding a sword

ShieldedRight_Walk.desc: Squat down with right arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Left arm as if holding a sword

SlideFeet_Walk.desc: Barely lift feet off the floor/kick into floor

Star_Walk.desc: Wide arms and legs. Arms slightly below horizontal

Strutting_Walk.desc: With swagger leant slightly back arms swinging freely

Superman_Walk.desc: Right arm raised like superman flying

Swat_Walk.desc: As if holding a rifle and raiding a building

Sweep_Walk.desc: Sweeping with a broom while moving

SwingArmsRound_Walk.desc: Swing arms round body (right in front left at back then switch)

SwingShoulders_Walk.desc: Rotate torso and shoulders left to right and back

Teapot_Walk.desc: One arm on hip other arm raised

Tiptoe_Walk.desc: Walk on toes with heels raised

TogetherStep_Walk.desc: Step left foot - then together – then right foot

WalkingStickLeft_Walk.desc: Walk with a stick – used broom handle

WalkingStickRight_Walk.desc: Walk with a stick – used broom handle

Waving_Walk.desc: Waving at somebody else at random

WiggleHips_Walk.desc: Hands raised in front of body wiggle hips side to side

WildArms_Walk.desc: Swing arms much more than normal almost punching into the air

WildLegs_Walk.desc: Kick legs into the air with each step
